skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the principles and functions of hypervisors, virtual machines, and resource management in virtualized environments.
Manage virtualized resources such as CPU, memory, storage, and network.
Analyze and design virtualized system architectures.
Apply problem-solving techniques to virtualization-related issues.
Collaborate effectively in teams to solve virtualization problems.
Develop the ability to independently seek, access, and utilize relevant resources for virtualization studies.
Enhance critical thinking skills in the context of virtualization technologies.
Effectively present and discuss virtualization concepts and solutions.
